topic_ko: 감정에 의한 지각 왜곡과 유사성 임계값 하강
_note: 빈칸(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab/blank의 밑줄·빈칸 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: Imagination keeps working even when perception is not actively identifying objects, as happens in states of emotion, illness, or sleep.
Emotions lead people to perceive the world in ways that are not accurate.
A fearful person's way of perceiving is shaped by his tendency to feel fear.
In the same way, a person in love has expectations shaped by longing.
In such states, even a slight resemblance between what one sees and what one expects can cause a false recognition.
The fearful person spots a threat; the one in love finds their beloved everywhere.
The stronger the emotional hold, the smaller the degree of likeness needed for such an error.
Ordinary perceptual processing involves balancing similarities and differences, but emotion overrides this balance, pushing toward inaccuracy.
The deeper the emotional engagement, the more skewed one's reading of the world becomes.
choices: the role of sleep and illness in sharpening perceptual accuracy
how emotional states reduce the similarity threshold needed for misperception
the benefits of emotional investment in accurate decision-making
methods for training the central organ of sense to resist bias
why fearful people are better at identifying threats than others
theme.explanation_ko: 감정이 강할수록 지각 오류(오인)에 필요한 유사성의 임계값이 낮아진다는 것이 글의 핵심 주제. ②가 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①수면·질병의 긍정적 효과, ③감정 투자의 의사결정 이점, ④중추 기관 훈련, ⑤겁쟁이의 위협 탐지 능력은 모두 본문의 초점이 아니다.

passage: When the mind is not carefully tracking objects, imagination takes over — in moments of strong feeling, illness, or dreamlike states.
Emotion skews the way we see reality.
A person ruled by fear will read fear into ambiguous signals.
A person driven by longing will see the desired object in the most unlikely places.
In both cases, only a faint resemblance is enough to trigger a mistaken recognition.
This happens because the stronger the emotion, the lower the bar for seeing what one expects.
The brain's normal task of weighing likenesses against differences is derailed by feeling.
The result: the more we feel, the less objectively we see.
Emotional intensity and perceptual accuracy move in opposite directions.
choices: How Imagination Improves Perceptual Skills in Fearful Situations
When Feeling Clouds Sight: Emotion and Perceptual Distortion
Why Accurate Perception Requires Strong Emotional Investment
The Role of Similarity in Training the Central Organ of Sense
How Sleep and Disease Affect the Brain's Identification System
title.explanation_ko: 감정이 지각을 흐리게 한다(왜곡시킨다)는 핵심을 압축한 ②가 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①상상이 지각 능력을 향상시킨다는 주장은 본문과 반대, ③정확한 지각에 감정 투자가 필요하다는 것은 본문 결론과 반대, ④⑤는 지엽적 내용이다.

passage: Imagination continues to function when perception is not actively discerning objects, in cases of emotion, disease, and sleep.
Emotions dispose one to see the world in a distorted way.
A coward's perceptual disposition is affected by his disposition to experiencing fear.
A lover's expectations are affected by desire.
In such cases, a small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can lead to the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing.
The coward sees the enemy, while the lover sees the object of desire everywhere.
The more affected one is, the less similarity is required for the thing to appear.
While the central organ of sense normally functions by comparing similarities and differences, emotions dispose one to discern objects inaccurately.
The greater the emotional investment, the more biased one's perception.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ disposition to + 동사원형이 올바른 형태. 'disposition to experiencing'에서 experiencing(동명사)은 틀리고 to experience(to부정사 원형)로 써야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①continues to function(to부정사 원형), ②dispose one to see(to부정사 원형), ④the less(The 비교급 ~ 구문), ⑤by comparing(전치사 by + 동명사) 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: Imagination keeps operating even when perception is not actively identifying objects, in states of emotion, illness, and sleep.
Emotions lead one to see the world in an accurate way.
A coward's perceptual tendency is shaped by his inclination to experience fear.
A lover's expectations are driven by desire.
In such states, a small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can result in the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing.
The coward spots the enemy, while the lover finds the object of desire everywhere.
The more emotionally affected one is, the less similarity is required for the thing to appear.
While the central organ of sense normally operates by comparing likenesses and differences, emotions cause one to discern objects inaccurately.
The greater the emotional investment, the more biased one's perception.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 감정은 세상을 '왜곡된(distorted)' 방식으로 보게 만든다는 것이 글의 핵심. accurate(정확한)는 문맥과 정반대이므로 distorted로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②tendency(경향), ③result in(~을 초래하다), ④required(필요한), ⑤biased(편향된)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Imagination keeps working even when we are not actively identifying objects — in states of emotion, illness, or sleep.
Emotional states dispose us to perceive the world in a distorted manner.
A cowardly person, whose judgment is governed by fear, will see threats where none exist.
A person in love, driven by longing, will detect the beloved's presence in ambiguous forms.
In each case, a minor resemblance between what is actually there and what is expected is sufficient to produce misidentification.
The coward and the lover alike project their inner states onto the outer world.
The more affected one is, __________.
This happens because emotion disrupts the central organ of sense, which normally balances similarities and differences.
Put simply, the deeper the emotional engagement, the more biased and inaccurate one's perception.
blank.blank_target: the less similarity is required for the thing to appear
choices: the more chances one gets to find differences
the less similarity is required for the thing to appear
the sooner the perceived similarity fades away
the more easily one can sense the world the way it is
the less slowly different emotions are released
blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 앞에서 '사소한 유사성만으로도 오인이 일어난다'고 했고, 뒤에서 '감정이 비교 기능을 방해하며 감정 투자가 클수록 지각이 더 편향된다'고 결론짓는다. 따라서 빈칸에는 감정이 커질수록 오인에 필요한 유사성 기준이 낮아진다는 ②가 들어가야 한다.
blank.distractor_ko: ①차이를 발견할 기회 증가는 본문 논리와 반대, ③유사성이 사라진다는 것은 근거 없음, ④있는 그대로 보기 쉬워진다는 것은 본문 결론과 반대, ⑤감정 방출 속도는 본문에 없는 개념이다.

order.given: Imagination continues to function when perception is not actively discerning objects, in cases of emotion, disease, and sleep. Emotions dispose one to see the world in a distorted way.

blocks.A: The more affected one is, the less similarity is required for the thing to appear. While the central organ of sense normally functions by comparing similarities and differences, emotions dispose one to discern objects inaccurately.
blocks.B: A coward's perceptual disposition is affected by his disposition to experience fear. A lover's expectations are affected by desire.
blocks.C: In such cases, a small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can lead to the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing. The coward sees the enemy, while the lover sees the object of desire everywhere.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(감정이 지각 왜곡) → (B)에서 겁쟁이·연인의 구체 성향 제시 → (C)에서 그 결과(작은 유사성으로 오인) 기술 → (A)에서 일반화 원리(더 영향받을수록 필요 유사성이 적다) 및 이론적 설명 제시. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 'In such cases'는 (B)의 겁쟁이·연인 사례를 받으므로 반드시 (B) 뒤에 온다. (A)의 일반 원리는 (C)의 사례를 받아 설명하는 흐름이다.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장('감정 투자가 클수록 지각이 더 편향된다')은 앞의 '감정이 비교 기능을 방해하고 부정확하게 식별하게 만든다'(⑤ 앞)는 설명의 자연스러운 결론이자 귀납적 일반화 문장이다. ⑤ 뒤에 놓이면 전체 글이 원인·사례·원리·결론 흐름으로 완성된다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①② 앞에는 아직 구체 사례가 나오지 않아 일반화 결론이 너무 이르다. ③④는 사례 중간이라 일반 원리가 흐름을 끊는다.

passage: Imagination operates even when perception is inactive, particularly in emotional states.
Emotions predispose individuals to perceive reality in distorted ways.
A person dominated by fear will perceive threats in ambiguous stimuli.
A person dominated by longing will detect a desired figure in uncertain forms.
Only a slight resemblance between an actual object and an expected one is needed to trigger misidentification.
The more emotionally engaged one is, the less similarity is required for this error to occur.
The central organ of sense is designed to compare likenesses and differences, but emotion overrides this function.
Ultimately, emotional intensity and perceptual accuracy are inversely related.
summary.summary_template: When a person is strongly influenced by emotion, the __(A)__ of similarity needed to misidentify an object decreases, because emotion __(B)__ the normal sensory function of comparing likenesses and differences.
summary.explanation_ko: (A) 오인이 일어나는 데 필요한 '정도(degree)'의 유사성이 낮아진다. (B) 감정은 정상 감각 기능을 '방해한다(disrupts)'. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) quality(질), absence(부재), frequency(빈도)는 문맥에 맞지 않음. (B) enhances(강화), supports(지지), replaces(대체)는 본문 논지('감정이 비교 기능을 방해')와 어긋난다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 감정에 더 많이 휘둘릴수록, 그 대상이 나타나는 데 필요한 유사성은 더 적어진다.
writing.answer: The more affected one is, the less similarity is required for the thing to appear.
writing.explanation_ko: The 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~ 구문. the more affected one is(주절1) + the less similarity is required for the thing to appear(주절2).

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 감정적 투자가 클수록 지각이 더 편향된다.
writing.answer: The greater the emotional investment, the more biased one's perception.
writing.explanation_ko: The 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~ 구문. the greater the emotional investment(주절1, 동사 is 생략) + the more biased one's perception(주절2, 동사 is 생략).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이러한 경우, 지각된 대상과 보기를 기대하는 대상 사이의 작은 유사성이 지각된 대상을 그 대상으로 잘못 인식하게 이끌 수 있다.
conditions: the thing one expects to see를 포함할 것
writing.answer: In such cases, a small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can lead to the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing.
writing.explanation_ko: lead to 뒤 명사구(the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing), 관계절 the thing one expects to see, 전치사 as 사용.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: While the central organ of sense normally functions by comparing similarities and differences, emotions dispose one to discern objects inaccurately.
writing.answer: 감각의 중추 기관은 정상적으로는 유사점과 차이점을 비교하여 기능하지만, 감정은 사람이 사물을 부정확하게 식별하도록 만든다.
writing.explanation_ko: while(대조 접속사), central organ of sense(감각의 중추 기관), dispose one to V(~하도록 만들다), discern inaccurately(부정확하게 식별하다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: When a person is strongly (A)___________ by emotion, their perception becomes more (B)___________, as the normal process of comparing similarities and differences is overridden.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 감정에 의해 '영향을 받는(affected)', (B) 그 결과 지각이 더 '편향된(biased)' 상태가 된다.

writing.context: Emotions ___________ one to see the world in a distorted way.
writing.explanation_ko: dispose + 목적어 + to-V: '~가 …하도록 성향을 갖게 하다/만들다'. 주어 Emotions(복수)에 맞는 동사원형 dispose.
